verdict.rationale: Orb's own docs show it generates invoices and can auto-issue them after grace periods, with an optional manual-approval mode. That covers the core of automatically issuing invoices, but nothing in the pack documents credit notes, receipts, numbering, custom fields or memos. Missing for 10: credit note and receipt documents, sequential invoice numbering, custom fields and memos on invoices, explicit automatic delivery to customers (e.g. email), tax/compliance formatting, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the platform generates compliant invoices, credit notes, and receipts — sequential numbering, custom fields, memos — delivered to customers automatically

citations.quote: Invoices auto-issue after grace periods and buffers
Require manual approval: Remain in draft until manually issued via the dashboard or API
